zero_progress_definition: No raw score high-water increase above reset baseline zero; exact nonpositive score and zero event count. Integer score events require no floating tolerance.
timing_of_freeze: Frozen before RANDOM execution and combined table computation; earlier TASK/MAX zero evaluation outcomes were already known. Not retrospective preregistration.
coverage_definition: Valid fresh pairs / max(floor(actual_decisions/15)-1,0); additionally report horizon-relative pairs/39 and warmup decisions.
segment_selection_rule: Per condition: highest sum of q impulses among zero-task-event contiguous60-decision evaluation segments, ties earliest seed/start; ordinary comparison is earliest episode decisions31-90. Rank using q impulses for all conditions regardless of delivered objective.
target_condition_rate_assumption: A/B/CONST use measured TASK/MAX range; unmeasured, update after integration.
